configuration.showAll.description: Show all Codex sessions instead of only sessions bound to the current workspace.

configuration.chatGroupLocking.descripti: Route new file opens outside matching chat groups. Automatically release managed locks when a group no longer matches or this setting is off. Groups adopted by the policy are managed as a whole; other group locks are left unchanged.
configuration.chatGroupLocking.off: Do not automatically lock editor groups.
configuration.chatGroupLocking.chatOnly: Lock groups containing only Codex chat tabs.
configuration.chatGroupLocking.containsC: Lock any group containing a Codex chat, including groups with code tabs.
